Update (US Eastern Time 5:36 PM): Apple has also released the fifth public beta of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a) and tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a).

Developers can now install the fifth beta of several upcoming software updates, including iPadOS 26.6. Read on for more details.

Fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6 and HomePod 26.6 now available

As the beta cycle for Apple's 26.6 software updates winds down, Apple has officially released the fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a), watchOS 26.6 (23U5062b), tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a), visionOS 26.6 (23O5765a) and HomePod 26.6 (23L5766a).

These updates are rolling out alongside the fifth betas of iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6, and are similarly focused on bug fixes, with some patches pushed out earlier due to the continued rise of security threats involving artificial intelligence.

This is most likely the final round of testing before the release candidate (RC) drops. With the final 26.6 versions imminent, attention has already begun shifting toward iOS 27 and related updates expected to launch publicly this fall. Apple is also expected to release the first public beta in the near future.

In any case, developers can now install the fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6 and other companion updates, with public versions expected within the next several days.
